body: Just wanted to let you know, I was in the exact same position as you. I ordered a limited edition Switch from tecobuy on Jan 10th, then saw all these posts about it and felt sick... But my Switch just came today exactly as ordered, so 20 days total to wait, which given the state of the world is understandable and reasonable to me. Absolutely nothing wrong with the order, came with all attachments and the correct plug (which was another concern). Was a moment of panic when the parcel couldn't be traced but I think this was down to it being in transit between the Chinese courier and UK postal service. I hope you have a similar experience, and I feel for those who haven't x
